header: Super-admin means the HOD of C&IT, who holds the highest and sole initial authority across all management facilities (Employee, PAX, Holidays, Circulars, Announcements, Contact Access Log). I declare the single source of truth in src/lib/constants.ts as HOD_CIT_TICKET. An optional SUPERADMIN_TICKETS environment variable can supply additional or overriding tickets if ever needed.

symbols.name: SUPERADMIN_TICKETS
symbols.sig: const SUPERADMIN_TICKETS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set( envTickets.length > 0 ? envTickets : [HOD_CIT_TICKET],)
